title: [Audit] Actor first-seen and footprint
description: One row per identity active in the selected range, all traffic: the identities the Identities tile counts, newest first appearance on top (up to 1,000). Events is everything the identity did, the same count as Busiest human identities; Signal events is what is left after the noise gate (health pings, query internals including dashboard and Discover reads, bulk authentication_success), the count the gated panels across the suite use, so an identity that only read dashboards shows few or none. IPs and Action types are distinct counts. Located in counts the countries its client IPs geolocate to, or, when none does, says why: “internal” (every address is private or carrier-NAT — Kibana or the platform calling on someone’s behalf, the word the failure session uses), “not located” (a public address the GeoIP database does not place) or “no IP”. First seen is bounded by the time picker: widen the range to tell a brand-new identity from one that was simply quiet. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email. On a rolling time range each panel reads “now” at the moment it loads, and the newest events reach the stream a few seconds late, so an identity still sending requests can show slightly different counts here and in a panel that loaded a moment apart.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | FORK (EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip), countries = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.geo.country_iso_code), ip_lo = MIN(client.ip), ip_hi = MAX(client.ip), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.event.action) BY actor) (WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"))) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/(elastic_)?cloud-audit-).*") OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((attributes.event.action == "saved_object_get" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (attributes.event.action == "saved_object_find" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR attributes.kibana.session.id IS NULL)))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS signal = COUNT(*) BY actor) | STATS first_seen = MIN(first_seen), last_seen = MAX(last_seen), events = MAX(events), signal = MAX(signal), ips = MAX(ips), countries = MAX(countries), ip_lo = MIN(ip_lo), ip_hi = MAX(ip_hi), actions = MAX(actions) BY actor | EVAL signal = COALESCE(signal, 0) | SORT first_seen DESC | LIMIT 1000 | KEEP actor, first_seen, last_seen, events, signal, ips, countries, ip_lo, ip_hi, actions | EVAL countries = CASE(countries == 1, "1 country", countries > 1, CONCAT(TO_STRING(countries), " countries"), ips == 0, "no IP", (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "100.64.0.0/10") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "100.64.0.0/10")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "10.0.0.0/8") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "10.0.0.0/8")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "172.16.0.0/12") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "172.16.0.0/12")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "192.168.0.0/16") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "192.168.0.0/16")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "127.0.0.0/8") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "127.0.0.0/8")), "internal", "not located") | DROP ip_lo, ip_hi | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME actor AS Identity, first_seen AS `First seen`, last_seen AS `Last seen`, events AS Events, signal AS `Signal events`, ips AS IPs, countries AS `Located in`, actions AS `Action types`
